name: Orbit Chews #22
description:
A space-themed chewing gum that evokes nostalgic and melancholy feelings of space exploration, flavored uniquely by tapping into the consumer's memories. Generates a warming sensation upon chewing.

EFFECT: Consuming the gum induces brief, vivid memories of space travel or exploration experiences, even if the consumer has never experienced them. This often results in a nostalgic or melancholic emotional state.
ANOMALOUS PROPERTIES: The chewing gum alters the flavor based on the consumer's memories, evoking a sense of nostalgia with each chew. Additionally, it generates a slight warmth without external heat sources.
TASTE: Varies based on individual memories, though consistently described as having a lingering sense of sweetness with metallic undertones.
PACKAGING: A compact pack of gum shaped like a space shuttle, predominantly metallic silver with blue accents. The name "Orbit Chews" is printed boldly along the side, accompanied by abstract glyphs resembling star maps.

RESEARCHER NOTE: The flavor-changing mechanism seems overpriced at ¥261, until one remembers the cost of emotional baggage is immeasurable.

Dispensed by SCP-261 on 2026-11-18 — edition #22 of the permanent record.
